ac1_proof.dead_addend_argument: Adding a constant is a bijection on Z/2^32 and Verilog `+` wraps, so a base addend shared by all eight addresses cancels out of every pairwise equality. The miter discharges this rather than relying on the argument.
ac1_proof.free_input_decomposition: 7 x 32 offsets incl. the lifted base addend, 8 x 8 present, 8 x 128 value
ac1_proof.head_side: instantiates the shipped lsc1_blake3_alias_check, not a transcription of it
ac1_proof.note: The scoping document quotes 1376 free bits. That figure counts nine independent 32-bit address inputs; the authored RTL derives the two companion addresses (cv+1, out+1) rather than accepting them, so the faithful lifting has seven. The smaller number is reported here because it is the one this proof actually discharged.

cells.caveat: A generic-gate count is not area, power or timing. It is reported only to show the extraction did not inflate the design.
